I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin's response shows it received every field as requested.

- **Customer:** Ada Lovelace, telephone 555-0100, email ada@example.com
- **Size:** Large
- **Toppings:** Bacon and Extra Cheese
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Instructions:** "Ring twice"

The result page (`https://httpbin.org/post`) is still open in my own tab, t2.

My first commands ran in a tab that turned out to be another agent's. It had navigated to saucedemo.com. A few of my form-filling commands (including typing "0745PM" into a field) may have landed there. I then opened my own tab and did the whole order there. That saucedemo tab is still open, and I didn't close it or touch it again.
